dct_title_s: Haiti Subnational Population and Housing Data Tables with Administrative Boundaries, Based on National Census and Surveys
dct_description_sm: The geodatabase contains national and subnational boundary feature classes of Haiti for joining (linking) to attribute data provided in tables prepared by the U.S. Census Bureau. The tabular data contain total population for 2003 (census) and 2015 (population estimates), as well as information relating to education, health, information and communication technology, and transportation.
